body:
The design list on the Design page doesn't update an expanded entry when a new version of that design arrives. The human has to reload to see it.

## Asked for

- The design list updates automatically when a new version arrives, including entries that are expanded.

## Done when

- An expanded design entry shows a new version as soon as it's saved, with no reload and without collapsing the entry.
- A test covers a live update reaching an expanded entry.
title: design list: open entries refresh
